title: 1123. Lowest Common Ancestor of Deepest Leaves

examples.explanation: We return the node with value 2, colored in yellow in the diagram. The nodes coloured in blue are the deepest leaf-nodes of the tree. Note that nodes 6, 0, and 8 are also leaf nodes, but the depth of them is 2, but the depth of nodes 7 and 4 is 3.
The root is the deepest node in the tree, and it's the lca of itself.
The deepest leaf node in the tree is 2, the lca of one node is itself.
